preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated tax fees in its balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the sweepContingency() function before liquidity is added to drain all BNB from the contract to the owner's address. This function transfers the contract's entire BNB balance to the owner and can only be called before liquidity is added (_hasLiqBeenAdded must be false).
